data.long_meaning: The name Jaeger is of German origin and translates to 'hunter' or 'warrior'. It was a common surname for those who hunted for a living, particularly in medieval Europe. The name Jaeger carries the meaning “Hunter, Warrior” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Jaeger usually hope their child will grow to embody hunter, warrior and live with faith, good character and purpose.
